_comment: The TYPO CLASS golden set (O20/S8 — the silent-failure class a 'safe' version bump regressed: Typesense v28 #2313). Each case is a typo'd query that MUST still return the correct doc via the engine's typo tolerance. Covers all three forms the override requires: single-char substitution, transposition, multi-word typo. The version-bump suite (truffle eval --suite version-bump) re-runs this after ANY engine bump; a miss is FLAGGED and attributed to the bump (never just raise the typo params).
